name: CodeScientist
description: Semi-automated scientific discovery system that ideates, plans and runs code-based experiments and writes up the findings.
whatItDoes: Generates experiment ideas from papers and code examples, implements and debugs them in a sandbox, and reports results. A researcher can steer it step by step or let batches run automatically.
howItWorks: A back-end server performs ideation, planning and an execute-and-debug loop over generated experiment code, while a separate web interface submits and monitors jobs. Both are Python processes started from the repository.

requirements.name: LLM provider API keys
requirements.description: Keys for the models used by the system

models: Hosted LLM APIs configured by the user
